statement: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
explanation: At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100°C.

statement: Humans only use 10% of their brains.
explanation: Brain scans show that nearly all regions of the brain have known functions.

statement: The Earth is the center of the Solar System.
explanation: The Sun is at the center of the Solar System.

statement: Sound travels faster in water than in air.
explanation: Sound travels about 4.3 times faster in water because water particles are packed denser than air.

statement: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
explanation: Lightning often strikes the same place repeatedly, especially tall objects like the Empire State Building.
